name: io.github.playtide-studios/steam-mcp
title: Steam MCP
description: Steam market intelligence MCP server for game developers: app search, trends, reviews, news.

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_MCP_BACKEND_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the companion backend base URL. Defaults to the Playtide hosted beta (https://api.playtide.dev).

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_MCP_AUTO_UPDATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable the boot-time update check against the vendor update channel.

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_MCP_UPDATE_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: Pin a different update channel URL.
